name: luismc-transcript-folds
description: Folds long diffs, finished shell commands and long hook messages to one line in the transcript. A diff over a set number of changed lines draws as one dim line with its path, first changed line and +added -removed counts; a finished Bash or PowerShell call draws as one row with its command and outcome, and the files it edited. A band above the prompt holds three buttons (diffs, commands, hooks) bound to the chords the person gives the engine actions theme:toggleSyntaxHighlighting (ctrl+x d), theme:editCustom (ctrl+x f) and settings:sortByTokens (ctrl+x h), and the session's tally of files and lines changed. A hook message (a line such as `Stop says: ...`) over foldHooksAbove words draws as its event name, first sentence and word count. /fold-diffs, /fold-commands and /fold-hooks flip the same switches; /fold-hooks diag shows what the hook matcher saw. Four settings: foldAbove, marker, compactCounts, foldHooksAbove. The mod writes no files and runs no commands.

foldAbove.title: Fold diffs above this many changed lines
foldAbove.description: A diff with this many changed lines (added plus removed) or fewer is drawn in full; 0 folds every diff.

marker.title: Marker
marker.description: Starts every folded diff line. Leave empty for none.

compactCounts.title: Compact counts
compactCounts.description: Put the added and removed counts on the tool call's own row and drop the line under it.

foldHooksAbove.title: Fold hook messages above this many words
foldHooksAbove.description: A hook message with this many words or fewer is drawn whole; 0 folds every hook message.
